offers_products.reason: Makes Reynolds Wrap foil, Hefty trash bags, food storage bags, tableware, and private-label Presto bags.

offers_services.reason: Sells only manufactured household goods; no service offering among its main lines.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Consumer brands (Reynolds, Hefty) sold through retailers; shoppers choose the brand.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to retailers for resale, including private-label Presto bags for retailers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Foil, trash bags, and food bags are consumables that households and retailers repurchase regularly.

cyclical_demand.reason: Household staples such as trash bags and foil are bought regardless of recession.

big_ticket.reason: Low-priced, frequently purchased consumables like foil, trash bags, and storage bags.

people_delivered.reason: Manufacturer of packaged goods; customers pay for products, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are large retailers (mass merchants, grocery chains) plus household shoppers; large retailers dominate sales channel.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates manufacturing plants for aluminum foil, resin bags and tableware, needing ongoing capital investment.

notes: Large-customer answer is judged by the retail channel; households are also end buyers.
